The '''DL-T heavy blaster pistol''' was a pistol undergoing tests and should not be available in general public. It is named "DL-T" due to its status as a testing weapon. Its appearance is a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] but has gold color on it. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], these pistols were found used by smugglers.

==Behind the scenes==
This pistol's schematic is obtained by completing a mission in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
